subject: Re: Timebox stretch request — Bellwether POC options
messages:
From: Alicia Nguyen <alicia@bellwether.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bellwether.ai
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 3-week timebox stretch for Bellwether POC

Hi Diego —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We made good progress ingesting our data but hit a small snag with permissions on our side (security team needs another round of review). We’re about 80% through validation and believe another 2–3 weeks will let us finish the main integration tests and provide a clean pass on the quality gates.

Can Redwood do a 3-week timebox stretch on the current POC at a reduced rate? We’re a bit tight on budget this quarter but want to avoid restarting the onboarding clock if possible. If you have an alternative (credits, milestone extension, or short-term seat swap) we’re open to options.

I’ve attached our current usage snapshot (Bellwether_POC_usage_report.csv) so you can see token curves and night/day patterns.

Best,
Alicia Nguyen
Senior Product Manager
Bellwether Analytics

[attachment: Bellwether_POC_usage_report.csv (CSV, 42KB)]

From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Nguyen <alicia@bellwether.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week timebox stretch for Bellwether POC

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the update and for sending the usage snapshot — that helps a lot. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate a 3-week stretch. Two pragmatic ways customers have handled this recently: 

1) Timebox extension with pro-rated credits: we extend the current POC by 3 weeks and provide a 25% credits-on-usage concession for the extended window (applies only to hosted usage during the extension). We’d capture that with a single addendum to the SOW.

2) Short-term capacity swap: if you want to keep the billing flat this quarter, we can shift up to 20% of the reserved capacity you’d get in a Dedicated contract into the POC window (essentially giving you higher throughput for the 3 weeks at no additional cost) — this is more operationally involved and requires a quick capacity check.

I’ve attached a proposed addendum draft (timebox-addendum-draft.pdf) and an updated SOW (POC-SOW-v2.pdf) to make review faster.

Couple quick notes: if procurement needs formal terms we’ll need a signed addendum + PO or a DocuSign envelope before we start the extension. If you prefer credits rather than a billing change, we can just apply the credit and push the extension live.

I’ll leave it to Ben and Marissa (cc’d) to comment on the margin implications and preferred internal approach.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

[attachments: POC-SOW-v2.pdf, timebox-addendum-draft.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alicia Nguyen <alicia@bellwether.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week timebox stretch for Bellwether POC

Diego / Alicia —

I recommend we go with option 1 (pro-rated credits) for three reasons: 1) fastest to execute (one-doc addendum + credit application), 2) keeps the POC in hosted where we can observe quality (helps conversion), 3) preserves flexibility for Bellwether to convert to Dedicated later. 

Operationally: propose 25% credit on projected incremental usage for the 3 weeks (cap the credit at the forecasted weekly avg * 3). If procurement pushes for zero-cost extension, we can use a slightly higher cap but require a PO for the full anticipated spend as a commitment-to-convert clause (lightweight).

Marissa — can you confirm the legal team is okay with the addendum language in timebox-addendum-draft.pdf? If legal wants changes, flag the redlines and I’ll loop in revenue ops.

Thanks,
Ben
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Nguyen <alicia@bellwether.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bellwether.ai, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T13:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week timebox stretch for Bellwether POC

Diego/Ben —

Thanks for the quick options. We prefer option 1 (credits + addendum). 25% credit cap sounds fair; procurement is asking for a short addendum and a single PO for visibility (they won’t sign anything with conversion obligations). We can generate the PO once the addendum is finalized. 

Couple of asks before we sign:
- Can you confirm the credit only applies to hosted inference usage and not to additional professional services?
- We need the addendum to include an explicit end date (three weeks from the signed date) and an SLA note that the existing POC performance baseline is maintained.

If you can update the addendum and send a DocuSign link, I’ll loop procurement and get the PO out quickly.

Thanks — Alicia

[one-line reply from procurement: "We’ll need the PO by Tue next week to keep our quarter clean."]

From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Nguyen <alicia@bellwether.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week timebox stretch for Bellwether POC — Addendum sent

Hi Alicia —

Thanks — we updated the addendum per your asks (credit scoped to hosted inference only, addendum end date fixed to three weeks after signature, and a short clause that maintains the current POC performance baseline). I pushed the updated addendum into DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/s/results?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d (link above).

Once signed and we receive the PO, we’ll apply the credit and flip the extension live the next business day. I’ve also attached the finalized PDF for procurement to review offline.

I’ll monitor the envelope and follow up if there are any stalls.

Best,
Diego
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

[attachment: timebox-addendum-draft.pdf (updated final)]
